sentiment.rationale: The company reported a solid Q4 with positive comps and a 2% increase in adjusted EPS, but forward guidance for fiscal 2026 is cautious: revenue guidance of $92B-$94B implies flat to 2% comp growth, and adjusted EPS guidance of $12.25-$12.75 is only slightly above the $12.28 reported for 2025, indicating no meaningful raise. Management explicitly states 'our outlook for 2026 remains cautious given the persistent volatility in housing macro' and flags continued pressure on big-ticket DIY. The guidance is essentially held flat with a cautious tone, warranting a slightly negative score.

summary.revenue: Q4 sales were $20.6 billion with comparable sales up 1.3%. Full year fiscal 2025 sales were $86.3 billion with positive comparable sales of 0.2%.
summary.eps: Q4 GAAP diluted EPS of $1.78; adjusted diluted EPS of $1.98. Full year adjusted EPS of $12.28, a 2% increase over last year.
summary.guidance: Fiscal 2026 sales range of $92 billion to $94 billion with comparable sales flat to up 2%. Adjusted diluted EPS guidance of approximately $12.25 to $12.75. Operating margin range of 11.2% to 11.4%; adjusted operating margin range of 11.6% to 11.8%.
summary.margin: Q4 adjusted gross margin 32.7%, down 18 bps. Adjusted operating margin 9%, down 41 bps. Full year adjusted operating margin 12.1%, flat to prior year excluding acquisitions.
key_risks: Persistent volatility in housing macro and elevated mortgage rates creating a lock-in effect, pressuring big-ticket discretionary DIY projects.
Uncertainty around tariff policy and its impact on costs.
Consumer confidence remains subdued due to inflationary pressures and economic uncertainty.
Unclear how much tax refunds will be spent on home improvement.
Q1 comp sales expected to be below the midpoint of full year guide due to severe winter storm activity in February.
key_opportunities: Pro business growth driven by expanded salesforce, Pro Extended Aisle, and new AI-enabled Pro Companion.
Online sales growth of 10.5% in Q4, with record holiday sales and strong app engagement.
Acquisitions of FBM and ADG expected to be accretive to adjusted EPS and provide cross-selling opportunities.
Structural demand drivers: home equity at record levels, aging homes (average 44 years), and need for 16 million new homes over next decade.
Perpetual Productivity Improvement (PPI) initiatives targeting $1 billion in productivity for 2026.

management_tone.label: cautious
management_tone.justification: Management explicitly states 'our outlook for 2026 remains cautious given the persistent volatility in housing macro' and repeatedly uses phrases like 'cautiously optimistic' and 'uncertainty' regarding the macro environment.
